card.greeting: Welcome aboard, dear traveler; let us prepare you for a gracious tea visit in Morocco.
card.title: Tea with a host family in Morocco

tips.tip: Accept and enjoy the tea as a gesture of welcome, and allow time for the shared moment.
tips.why: Mint tea is closely associated with social life in the Maghreb and is offered to guests as hospitality; traditional Moroccan gatherings also center on ceremonial tea service.
tips.evidence: Mint tea is central to social life in the Maghreb and is very popular among the Tuareg people

tips.tip: Expect more than one serving, and take each glass as it is offered if you would like to continue.
tips.why: Serving tea in several rounds is part of the traditional guest service, with each glass taking on a different flavor as it steeps.
tips.evidence: Typically, at least three glasses of tea are served.

tips.tip: Receive the tea appreciatively; the host’s preparation and offering are part of the act of hospitality.
tips.why: Tea service has a ceremonial form when prepared for a guest, and offering it is described as a sign of hospitality.
tips.evidence: The serving can take a ceremonial form, especially when prepared for a guest.

tips.tip: Be open to the tea’s sweetness and changing flavor from one glass to the next.
tips.why: Sugar is a basic ingredient, while leaves remain in the pot as the tea is served, changing the flavor between glasses.
tips.evidence: The leaves are left in the pot while the tea is consumed, changing the flavor from one glass to the next.

tips.tip: If tea is accompanied by food, follow your hosts’ lead; communal eating is customary at social gatherings.
tips.why: Moroccan food traditions emphasize communal meals alongside the ceremonial serving of tea at gatherings.
tips.evidence: Traditional communal eating habits and ceremonial tea service are central to social gatherings.

tips.tip: It is considered more courteous not to assume every family serves tea in precisely the same way.
tips.why: Tea ingredients and brewing time differ, and Moroccan tea may also be perfumed with additional herbs, flowers, or orange blossom water.
tips.evidence: The proportions of the ingredients and the brewing time can vary widely.

card.closing: Thank you for traveling with us, dear traveler; your host’s own guidance is always the finest guide.
